article.story: BOWLING GREEN, Ohio -- — Max Weisbrod had 24 points in Northern Illinois’ 86-68 victory over Bowling Green on Saturday. Weisbrod also added seven assists for the Huskies (4-3). David Douglas Jr. went 7 of 14 from the field (5 for 9 from 3-point range) to add 21 points. Jack Daugherty shot 6 for 7, including 3 for 4 from beyond the arc to finish with 15 points. Tristan Beckford led the way for the Falcons (3-2) with 22 points and 11 rebounds. Josiah Shackelford added 17 points for Bowling Green. Makhi Leach also had 13 points. Northern Illinois took the lead for good with 13:15 remaining in the first half. The score was 35-28 at halftime, with Daugherty racking up 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
